_about: Translation rules: real deeds -> XP and temper (attribute growth). Edit numbers here, never in code. After any change run: python3 engine/darrow.py sync

levels._formula: XP to reach level L = 50 * L * (L - 1)
levels._about: The ladder runs past the Unkneeling on purpose. Unbowed (level 25) is this saga's summit: at a Costly pace it lies beyond the finale, at a Hard-won pace or better it lands about where the knee is whole again, so the comeback's quality decides whether he earns the name before Book VI ends. Warden of the Ember (level 30) belongs to what comes after: the sequels' rank. Resolve passing the Knight Who Fell early is by design (the GM file: he will not notice when he does).

attributes._formula: score = base + floor(sqrt(temper / divisor)), then capped by the Knots of the Binding

caps_by_knots._about: Highest score an attribute can show for a given number of Knots tied. Temper earned above the cap is banked and released when the next Knot ties.

morning_check.label: Morning knee check, swelling graded
morning_check._about: From needs_sleep_from on, the morning check is the swelling grade and last night's minutes of sleep together (his rule, 11/18): a grade without the minutes is not a check yet. Earlier mornings keep what they were paid for the grade alone, so nothing the page has shown changes.

sport_session._about: One award per sport_log session a day (the session column: A/B/C/film/test/review), up to per_day_cap; a session's skill rows count once for XP and temper, and each skill's Art practice counts separately.
sport_session.label: Sport skill session

pool_session._about: One award a day with a pool row in swim_log.csv (session pool), whatever the visit's length. Paid only from the day the PT's word on the pool is recorded (real/swim.json -> cleared; the master plan lists swimming 'as cleared'): a visit before it is kept in the log at zero.
pool_session.label: Pool visit

water_practice._about: The program's home routine (swim_log.csv, session home): one small award a day, like creatine. Dry work, so it waits on no clearance.
water_practice.label: Water practice at home

water_first._about: A milestone of the swim program recorded as done (real/swim.json; `darrow.py swim pass`), paid on its day, once. Like a pool visit, paid only from the day the PT's word on the pool is recorded.
water_first.label: A first in the water

sleep_near.label: Sleep within 30 min of target
sleep_near._about: The night's target is the Ledger's (real/config.json -> sleep_targets.min_per_night, 480). threshold is the share of it that still counts, like kcal_near: 0.9375 of 480 is 450 minutes. A night at the target or close to it is one day of practice for the Art sleep feeds (tag `sleep`); more than the target pays nothing more.

floor_7_of_7.label: Floor minimum every day of the week

sleep_week.label: The week's sleep at target
sleep_week._about: The week's nights (Sun-Sat, each logged on the day he woke) sum to real/config.json -> sleep_targets.min_per_week. A sum, so a long night may cover a short one; no close band; never part of the week score or the chapter tier.

week_score._about: 0-100. Sets the chapter's outcome tier. Red-light days (plan says rest) are excused, not counted against. roll_mod rides every climax die; target_odds is the chance of a full success each climax check is set to have (the brief prints the DC that gives it, from his modifiers that week: darrow.py odds), so a strong week's checks are very likely and a thin week's are even or worse (since 11/5: Hard-won 0.65, Costly 0.5, Setback 0.35, so a thin week can genuinely fail), and the dice can still fail.

overshoot._about: Golden rule 6: work past the plan is logged truthfully and pays nothing. From this date on: a knee session the day after another, knee or upper sessions beyond the week's planned count, optional add-ons beyond once a week or before their start date (real/config.json -> weekly_template.optional_from), and conditioning minutes past the plan's ceiling (real/config.json -> conditioning.cap_min). Earlier days keep what they paid, so nothing the page has shown changes.

ember._about: Rolling 7-day fuel score, 0-100, from logged days only. Day fuel = kcal_weight*(kcal/target)^exp + protein_weight*(protein/target)^exp, each ratio capped at 1.

inspiration._about: Cap on held Inspiration. Earned by a week with the daily minimum every day (weekly.floor_7_of_7), a Triumph week (weekly.triumph_inspiration), every level gained from per_level_from on (per_level each), and an Art turning into a new tier (art_tiers.inspiration_on_turn). Spent by him: an option tagged *[Inspiration]* at a climax or a small choice (saga.py choose spends it; the default never carries one), or `darrow.py roll --reroll`. auto_reroll_on_fail: a climax check that fails outright is cast again on his Inspiration once (his standing rule, 10/27; once only since 11/5): a second cast never comes clean (its success reads as a partial, success at a cost) and a second failure stands; the two dice lines and the Inspiration line between them go on the page as one block.

tether._about: The Tether: time together on purpose, logged as daily_log.csv -> together=Y (nothing else about it is recorded, and it is never scored). Its stage is the count of such days against `stages`, like an Art's ranks, and it only ever climbs: a quiet week is a thread at rest, never a thread frayed. No XP, no temper. The sheet shows it from stage I; each stage unlocks one planned scene (saga/bible/_gm/arc.md -> rae.tether). Her regard is story-only and moves by choices alone.

works._about: The works: real goals outside the knee, run in 2-5 tasks (real/projects.json, `darrow.py project`). No XP and no temper: the Reckoning is the leg's. A finished project counts in the sheet's WORKS and brings inspiration_per_finished Inspiration (capped like the rest); its tale (saga/bible/_gm/tales.md) pays a piece per task and a keepsake at the end. Only the counts reach the sheet and the site.

water._about: The Water: the learn-to-swim program's ladder as the sheet reads it (real/swim.json: four stages of milestones; `darrow.py swim`). A stage is reached when every milestone of it and of the stages before it is done; it only ever climbs. Each stage brings inspiration_per_stage Inspiration (capped like the rest) and one planned scene (saga/bible/_gm/arc.md -> darrow.water). `allows` is what the page may let him do in water at that stage, in story terms (`before`: until the first stage); the brief prints the line that holds. It limits his skill, never the plot: water past what he has learned is danger to him, and the page may still put him in it. The sheet shows it from stage I. Nothing here reads until the PT's word on the pool is recorded (real/swim.json -> cleared).
water.name: The Water
water.before: has never been seen to swim: he keeps to bridges, stones and boats, and water over his chest is a danger to him

stages.name: the shallows
stages.proves: he can put his head under and come up easy
stages.allows: goes under in water he can stand in and comes up calm, eyes open; he still does not swim, and water over his head is a danger to him

stages.name: the crossing
stages.allows: lies back on still water and lets it carry him, and swims a short reach of water he could stand in; nothing deep, nothing fast

stages.name: the deep
stages.proves: he can stay up where there is no floor
stages.allows: swims and stays afloat in deep, slow water with someone watching; never alone in it, never in a spate

stages.name: the leap
stages.proves: he can leave a height for deep water and come up swimming
stages.allows: leaps into deep water from a bank, a bridge or a rail, comes up and swims to the edge; headfirst only where the water is known to be deep

tags._about: Which real practice feeds which Art. Exercise-log 'block' and 'session' values map to tags here. A block is the progression the drill belongs to, one per movement (real/plan/working_rules.md -> Log files): landing is land-and-stick, plyo is leaving the ground, and balance counts only from a balance drill's own row.

arts.name: The Seated Blade
arts.effect: Fight at full Might from a fixed position; no penalty for being unable to move.

arts.name: Iron Grip
arts.effect: Cannot be disarmed; advantage to bind and hold a blade.

arts.name: Hammerfall
arts.effect: One blow per fight that staggers whatever it lands on.

arts.name: Stillwater Stance
arts.effect: Advantage to keep footing; cannot be knocked down while braced.

arts.name: The Long Breath
arts.effect: Recover once per fight; endure where others tire.

arts.name: The Mender's Patience
arts.effect: +Rank to Resolve checks against fear, haste and temptation.

arts.name: Warden's Eye
arts.effect: Read a weakness or a lie; +Rank to Insight.

arts.name: Morning's Counsel
arts.effect: Once a chapter, sleep on an open choice and wake knowing which road hides the most. Rank III: one true thing about that road. Rank V: about the road he names. +Rank to one read of a person or a lie when the counsel comes.

tiers.2: It also works on a scene already past: he may sleep on something he saw and wake knowing what he missed.

arts.name: Groundbreaker
arts.effect: Drive through a line; Might checks on foot gain +Rank.

arts.name: Soft Landing
arts.effect: Take falls and drops without harm.

arts.name: The Long Road
arts.effect: Travel and pursue without exhaustion.

arts.name: Thunderstep
arts.effect: Leap gaps, walls and horses.

arts.name: Hawk's Stoop
arts.effect: Close any distance before a bow can be drawn twice.

arts.name: Anchor
arts.effect: Stop dead at full speed; break a charge.

arts.name: The Turning Blade
arts.effect: Turn at speed and strike from the turn.

arts.name: The Quickening
arts.effect: Act before the enemy finishes deciding.

sport_arts._about: Set by /sport (10/9): maps a sport_log 'skill' (config.json -> sport.skills) to an Art. knot = the Knot from which the skill's first phase of practice opens (real/plan/sport_plan.md section 3); practice before it is banked.

arts.name: The Measured Hand
arts.effect: Whatever he throws lands where he means it to, at the pace he means: a blade into a friend's palm, a stone that only taps the shutter. Advantage to place a thrown thing.

arts.name: The Wicket Gate
arts.effect: Thread a thrown or passed thing past a man standing in its way; a guard in the line stops it only if he wins a contest for it.

arts.name: The Liar's Shoulder
arts.effect: Sell a false intention with the body. Once per scene, a foe who reads him commits the wrong way: advantage on the next check against that foe.

arts.name: Overwall
arts.effect: Throw over a shield, a wall or a crowd and drop it into the space behind; what stands between him and the mark gives it no cover.

arts.name: The Far Cast
arts.effect: A long throw a running ally can take: the rope across the river, the sword across the hall, landing where the runner will be.

arts.name: Tell-Reading
arts.effect: Watch a foe's hips and hands and know his next move before he makes it. Once per scene, ask what an opponent means to do.

arts.name: The Shadow-Step
arts.effect: Mirror a foe and stay between him and what he wants: advantage to hold a doorway, cut off a flight, or shadow a duelist step for step.

swim_arts._about: Set 11/27 with the swim program: maps a swim_log 'skill' (config.json -> swim.skills) to an Art of the Water tree. Practice is the days a skill was logged, in the pool or (breath only) at home. An Art opens on the day its own first is done (`first`: a milestone id of real/swim.json) and its Knot is tied; practice before that is banked, as with a Knot. knot = what the movement asks of the knee (plunge is a leap: Knot V).

arts.name: The Quiet Under
arts.effect: Go under and keep his head: the breath let out slow, eyes open, up again where he chose and without a sound. Advantage to pass unseen through water, and to stay calm wherever air is short.

arts.name: Otter's Rest
arts.effect: Lie back on still water and let it carry him. He can rest there as long as he needs, hands idle, and find his feet again when he likes.

arts.name: The Skyward Turn
arts.effect: Once a scene, when the water is winning, turn his face to the air and breathe: a failing swim becomes a rest, and he may try again.

arts.name: Bank to Bank
arts.effect: Cross water under his own power. A river is a road to him where it was a wall; a check to swim a crossing gains +Rank.

arts.name: Swan's Feet
arts.effect: Hold his place where there is no floor under him, head up and hands free: time to think, to take a rope, to wait out a searcher on the bank.

arts.name: Kingfisher's Fall
arts.effect: Leave a height for deep water and go in clean: a bank, a bridge, a wall, a ship's rail. He comes up where he meant to, already moving.

art_tiers._about: Past rank V an Art turns over into a new tier and climbs again. `ladder` is the days of practice for every rank of every tier (the first tier is art_ranks; a rank every 20 days in the second, every 30 in the third; add a tier here for a sequel). The dice never read past rank V: a higher tier adds no number to a check. What a turn brings: inspiration_on_turn Inspiration that day (capped like the rest), a new line on the Art (arts[].tiers: {"2": …, "3": …}, written when the Art gets there; sync says when one is owed) and a Wardrobe piece (an unlock's `rank` counts every step: 6 is the second tier's first rank, 11 the third's).

knots.name: The Knot of Straightening
knots.proves: the leg can be made straight
knots.allows: the leg lies straight on the blanket; he is carried, or on crutches; nothing on the leg

knots.name: The Knot of Walking
knots.allows: walks on his own legs on the flat: the hall, the court, the wall-walk by the gate; no stair down, no running, no fight on his feet, nothing that tests the Binding (the soft season: the quiet is a liar)

knots.name: The Knot of Standing
knots.allows: stands and bears weight on the leg: a stair with a hand on the wall, the forms standing; still no running, no leap, no fight on his feet

knots.name: The Knot of the Road
knots.allows: runs on the flat and on the road; no hard landing, no sprint, no turning at speed

knots.name: The Knot of Lightning
knots.proves: it can leap, land, sprint and stop
knots.allows: leaps, lands, sprints and stops dead; not yet the turn at speed

knots.name: The Knot of Turning
knots.proves: it can turn at speed: the movement that broke it
knots.allows: turns at speed and fights on his feet; the movement that broke it is his again

knots.name: The Knot of the Field
knots.allows: whole for battle: nothing the leg may not do

knots_about: `allows`: what the page may let the leg do once this Knot is tied, in story terms (the brief prints the tied Knot's line; the real plan clears the real knee, never the story)
